notes: Not S3-compatible: access is through SSH-based protocols (SFTP, SCP, rsync, Borg), FTP/FTPS, SMB, WebDAV/HTTPS; rclone and restic are listed on the product page. Port 22 (SFTP/SCP) and port 21 (FTP/FTPS) are always active; other protocols must be enabled.
Plans include a number of snapshots and sub-accounts (see the product page); snapshots are not object lock.
Plan capacities and prices change; the monthly price is null until it can be read from an official source.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Traffic is described as unlimited, so no allowance figure applies.

price.note: Docs: 'Each Storage Box comes with unlimited traffic.'

notes: Unlimited traffic is as stated in the documentation; fair-use terms were not checked.

object_lock.note: No object lock or immutability feature is documented on the pages checked; snapshots exist but are a different feature.
